preservationRule: all predecessor model identifiers remain in force; this delta adds ABI-v3 structural threats only

v3Threats.scenario: A caller substitutes a manifest or deployment commitment while keeping the actual P2SH20 source locks unchanged.
v3Threats.control: Source locks select exact embedded P3DM/P3RI bytes; caller derived facts are absent.

v3Threats.scenario: A caller supplies an action tag inconsistent with state values or topology.
v3Threats.control: Action follows only checked +/-10,000,000 sat state delta and TxView re-derives it.

v3Threats.scenario: A generic, swapped, or foreign redeem/frame/source is substituted at a carrier position.
v3Threats.control: Ordinal-specific P3RI redeems and exact full-byte frame/final-redeem checks.

v3Threats.scenario: An FT-only or immutable-empty-NFT projection enters a role requiring NONE.
v3Threats.control: Any nonempty category or commitment rejects outside the state role; no token-kind repair is accepted.

v3Threats.scenario: A static deployment label is presented as runtime proof of physical network identity.
v3Threats.control: networkTag is documented as lock-selected deployment domain only.
v3Threats.residual: identical-history physical-chain replay remains unmitigated here

v3Threats.scenario: A role is evaluated at another input while shared bytes falsely include one dynamic active index.
v3Threats.control: Each role-local consumption checks its fixed index; no active index appears in TxView.

v3Threats.scenario: A nonminimal wrapper, suffix, truncation, same-payload/different-script, or ordinal reordering changes full carrier bytes.
v3Threats.control: Full canonical two-push script parsing and ordered carrier-session binding.

v3Threats.scenario: Endian, signed, width, decimal, or >=2^63 integer aliases alter state/topology meanings.
v3Threats.control: Exact lower-case LE8 runtime parsing with <=0x7fffffffffffffff and nonwrapping transitions.

v3Threats.scenario: A leaf is omitted, duplicated, wildcarded, reclassified, or given an undeclared dependency.
v3Threats.control: Exact roster/table comparison and dependency-node validation.

v3Threats.scenario: Session, envelope, schedule, carrier, or provenance results feed proof/public-input/payload generation.
v3Threats.control: Exact acyclic dependency graph and source restrictions.

v3Threats.scenario: Always-false nondeployable artifacts are reported as accepting, measured, or qualified.
v3Threats.control: OP_FALSE compiler and explicit nonclaims; selected proof, VM, and measurement remain deferred.
